name: Huang et al. Voxelization Method
definition: Rasterizes triangles into a Morton-coded voxel subgrid using a three-stage overlap test (vertex spheres, edge cylinders, plane-barycentric check) to determine which voxels are filled.
summary: Huang et al. Voxelization Method rasterizes triangle meshes into a Sparse Voxel DAG using Morton-coded subgrids and a three-stage overlap test, enabling out-of-core processing of large meshes.
